_readme: User-visible changes in the replacement app, newest first.

entries.summary: Smart Skip: one text size, near-black surfaces (trial), and Compare with lists only usable languages
detail: Every piece of text on the Smart Skip page is one size (17px on desktop, 15px on a phone); only the page title and sheet titles are larger. Weight and colour carry the hierarchy.
Trial, Smart Skip page only, dark theme: rule cards, the word list, chips and sheets use near-black surfaces (#0d0e10) instead of the slate blue-grey.
Compare with shows only known languages this deck has look-alike data for; a known language without data no longer appears as a chip that does nothing.

entries.summary: Smart Skip desktop: sidebar reaches the bottom, More rules folded, larger text, no header line
detail: The page is sized from the window edges instead of 100dvh, which the app's page zoom shrank (at 0.9 zoom the page ended 90px short of the bottom).
Desktop: the rules sidebar and the word list each fill the height below the header and scroll on their own; the chips stay at the top of the list.
Desktop: More rules is folded behind one row by default and unfolds in place.
Desktop: wider sidebar (up to 400px) and larger text throughout the rules and the list.
Removed the hairline under the header; the sidebar's divider stays.

entries.summary: Smart Skip page redesign: one-line header, rules sidebar on desktop, compact switches and sheets on phones, chips above the word list
detail: Header: centred 'Smart Skip' title on desktop, words-skipped count, a page on/off switch and close button; the page background is black in the dark theme.
Desktop: full-width page; the rules sit in a sidebar running to the bottom edge with every description shown, including 'Compare with' language chips and the optional rules listed in place.

Phone: the two main switches and a 'More rules' row sit in one card above the list; each rule's description (and the look-alike languages) opens from its ⓘ as a bottom sheet, as does More rules. The Rules/Skipped words tabs, the browse banner, tagline and emoji icons are gone.

Word list: the category dropdown is now a row of chips; look-alikes with more than one known language get an English | French style switch, and the column header names the language shown, so rows need no language label.
Flags removed from Smart Skip column headers, the language switch and the look-alike language chips; languages are named in words.
Replaced the 700-line !important Smart Skip block in ui-refinements.css with one scoped set of styles.

entries.summary: Sense information modals: removed boilerplate 'Sense details' header
detail: Eliminated the visible 'Sense details' uppercase eyebrow text so the modal opens straight to the unpacked content.
Preserved accessible modal labeling via aria-label on the dialog.
Added top-right close button clearance for the first content section.

entries.summary: Sense information modals: delta-only details, eliminated original dictionary text repetition, and inflection-aware deduplication
detail: Eliminated the "Original dictionary text" section entirely from learner information modals to avoid repetitive dumps.
Removed the redundant meaning h2 header inside the dialog so the modal only shows newly unpacked delta details.
Added inflection-aware stem matching so inflected card rows (e.g. "remembers", "bales") correctly deduplicate against citation-form notes (e.g. "to remember", "a bale").
Preserved raw dictionary context in the underlying data object while promoting genuine context clauses into the Usage section.

entries.summary: Verb drills: plain-text tense, mood pill only when mixed, progress bar key toggle, and default selection guard
detail: Card: tense is styled matching person without a pill container; mood is omitted for indicative and only appears as a tag when drilling multiple moods.
Card: fixed empty stub oval caused by clue pill CSS overriding the hidden attribute.
Setup: removed Resume button; total count displays breakdown (verbs · tenses · persons); progress bar is tappable to reveal/hide its mastery key.
Setup: safe default selection guaranteed (present tense and all persons) so the drill never loads empty.

entries.summary: Verb drills: icon buttons for table and sentences, and the close button now steps back one level
detail: Card: 'see the table' and 'see sentences' are now icon buttons (table grid, speech bubble) on their own line under the regular/irregular pill.
Close button: in the conjugation menu it returns to the Extra menu; inside a drill it returns to the conjugation menu (the round is saved, so Resume still works).

entries.summary: Verb drills: simpler Start box, answer hidden until you tap, and person → tense linked on the card
detail: Setup: removed the verbs/tenses/persons line; the bar now shows progress (known / learning / missed) and the line under it is just 'N of M known · N due'.
Card: fixed the answer showing before you tap (a display rule was overriding the hidden attribute).

Card: person and tense now sit on one row (yo → Indicative · Present) with the verb underneath; removed the 'Subject' label; reflexive/participle moved next to the translation; type and pattern merged into one chip.

entries.summary: Front POS pill moved up to sit just under the card's top edge on phones
detail: Card front, phones: the centred POS/lemma pill(s) now sit 18px below the card's top edge (was 76px), so they read as the card's heading; the Card N of M pill follows underneath.

entries.summary: Verb drills: collapsible tense groupings with pill buttons, Start box at top, simplified header, and robust embedded loading
detail: Grouped tenses by mood (Indicative, Subjunctive, Imperative) into collapsible sections so they stay compact, with active moods open by default.
Replaced text toggles with clean, neutral pill buttons for 'all' / 'none' and '+ X' rarer tenses, removing garish red styling.
Moved the Start summary box to the top of setup with ordered settings below, and simplified header to title + close button.
Unified conjugation mode into a zero-latency embedded view with /conjugation URL and shared deck promise caching.

entries.summary: Scrubber number now moves one card at a time on grammar-word cards; POS pill fills the sense row; 'from' aligned; scrubber circle back to its original size
detail: Fixed the seek-bar number freezing on grammar-word cards (en, lo, un, por…) and then jumping several numbers: updateCard returned early after drawing their back, before the scrubber update.
Sense-row POS pill text 17→19px; the row's own padding cut (7px → 3px) so the pill nearly fills it.
'from' in the sense-row head now sits on the pill's centre line instead of floating above it.
Scrubber circle back to 32px (it had grown to 40px); its number is 19px so it fills the circle instead.

entries.summary: Companion cards: all three now reach the deck, and the front shows "Card N of M · x% of uses" on one clear pill; back-of-card controls enlarged again with tighter padding
detail: Fixed 3-way split words (e.g. fue) stopping at card 2: the deck builder only pushed the first two companions. Sessions also no longer cut a 3-card split across two batches.
Front: "Card N of M" is now 16px bold on a tinted pill, with "x% of uses" beside it instead of under the frequency (the frequency is the same on every companion).
Back: pin icon 26→30px, information icon 18→23px in a 30px box, sense-row POS pill 15→17px with 3px 10px padding, scrubber circle 36→40px with a 20px number, 'Level x' label 17→20px.

entries.summary: Enlarge row pin icon, sense info icon, sense-row POS pill, and level scrubber circle and label
detail: Increased sense-row pin icon (.sense-pin-icon) from 22x22px to 26x26px.
Increased sense information trigger (.sense-note-trigger) from 14px (22x22px box) to 18px (28x28px box).
Enlarged the POS pill on the sense section row (.pos-section-label) from 13px (24px height, 3px 9px padding) to 15px (28px height, 5px 12px padding).
Enlarged the level scrubber thumb circle and number (.cbs-thumb) from 32px / 13px to 36px / 16px, and the 'Level x' label (.study-level-label) from 14px to 17px.

entries.summary: Move memory tip lightbulb to headword corner, rename Pin meaning(s), and add 5-tile compact fallback
detail: Moved the memory tip trigger out of the bottom action row to an unboxed golden lightbulb at the top-right corner of the back headword (.headword-memory-tip-btn) so learner cards in ES/PT/CS/NL/FI never exceed 4 bottom buttons.
Renamed the bottom button label from "Pin a meaning" to "Pin meaning(s)" across live cards, tutorial steps, and card replicas.

Added a .links-section:has(> :nth-child(5)) compact layout and horizontal scroll fallback for the rare 5+ tile case (such as when Synonyms or the admin Dictionary button is present alongside Rare uses, Pin meaning(s), Conjugate, and Look up).

entries.summary: Deduplicated sense note modals with consolidated sections, filtered row tags, and polished dialog styling
detail: Changed modal eyebrow from "Usage notes" to "Sense details" to eliminate label repetition above "Usage" sections.
Filtered redundant raw context and gloss clauses under "Original dictionary text" that merely echoed previously rendered meaning and usage notes.
Consolidated matching sections across grouped card rows so duplicate "Usage" and "Grammar" headers are merged instead of stacked consecutively.
Enhanced modal overlay with animated scale/fade entrance, fallback border coloring, and dynamic inherit of the card's accent color.

entries.summary: Flick velocity grading, seamless swipe release trajectory, 2D damped follow, and deck-rise card entrance
detail: Added horizontal flick velocity recognition (>= 0.45 px/ms past 22px) so quick thumb flicks commit and fire the 8ms haptic tick without needing a full 50px drag.
Preserved exact release coordinates (--swipe-from-x/y/rot) into the exit keyframes so swiped cards fly off smoothly from the finger lift point, while cancelled drags spring back via .swipe-rebound.
Added 16% damped vertical follow, grab-point tilt scaling, and a 200ms deck-rise entrance animation (.card-deck-enter) for incoming cards on both mobile and desktop.

entries.summary: Unboxed 22x22 pushpin icons with full-gutter touch targets and 2px sense-matched POS indent rail
detail: Removed box border and background from .sense-pin-btn while increasing the pushpin SVG icon to 22x22 inside a 38x36px full-height gutter hit zone.
Changed .pos-collapsible.is-open .meaning-pos-rows vertical rail to 2px solid rgb(var(--sense-match-rgb)) and reduced its indent from 13px to 9px.
Widened .pct-column for pinned/pinning group rows and kept grouped sub-senses expanded while pinning mode is active.

entries.summary: Modernised card swipe feedback with progressive edge glow, frosted SVG badges, and threshold haptic tick
detail: Replaced the 72px raw Unicode ✗ and ✓ characters with frosted circular SVG badges that scale progressively with finger drag and snap solid with a spring bounce at the 50px commit threshold.
Added continuous emerald (right) and warm coral (left) edge wash and specular rim lighting on the card surface during horizontal swipes.
Added an 8ms micro-haptic tick at the exact frame the swipe crosses the 50px grade threshold, with no competing sound effects.

entries.summary: Keep newer answers safe while earlier saves are queued or retried
detail: Coalesced offline saves now update both memory and durable storage.
Answers made during a save keep their own pending operation.
Coalesced retries append newly gained review history without reusing event identifiers.

entries.summary: Restore SafariMS admin and Joshua/JP reviewer access after sign-in migration
detail: Bind admin and reviewer access to verified login identities in the app and server, including staging.
Quick reports capture the meaning and exact example currently displayed, with release/deck context.
Keep whole-card reporting available to JP; protect flags from cross-account overwrites.

entries.summary: Full-screen blurred backdrop overlay for Smart Skip word-filtering animation
detail: Added a fixed full-screen blurred backdrop overlay (backdrop-filter: blur(10px)) that activates when Smart Skip is pressed.
Centered the skipping animation card with frosted glass styling and smooth entrance/exit scaling in the viewport.
Fades the blur overlay and HUD out gracefully once word skipping completes, revealing the updated level stats.

entries.summary: Match Smart Skip size to Study button with glowing white indicator on active state
detail: Scaled the Smart Skip action button to 52px height, 22px padding, and 16px bold typography matching the exact footprint of Study and Practise.
Applied solid Study accent background fill with crisp white text and a bright glowing white LED indicator dot when toggled ON.
Preserved the clean neutral outline card state with hollow dot when OFF to maintain immediate clarity of the disabled state.

entries.summary: Refine Smart Skip into unified status-dot action pill and center Practice summary text
detail: Replaced the internal sliding switch with a sleek illuminated status dot indicator (○ Off / ● On) inside the unified Smart Skip action pill.
Tightened vertical spacing and removed dead-space padding around the Smart Skip footer so it sits cleanly and compactly beneath Study without large gaps.
Centered the Practice section summary text ('X waiting' / 'Nothing to practise yet') and chevron above the Practise button, matching the centered symmetry of Study.

entries.summary: Balance setup headers spacing and add sliding switch affordance to Smart Skip toggle
detail: Embedded a sliding iOS-style pill track and thumb inside the unified Smart Skip button with smooth CSS transforms and theme-adaptive coloring.
Trimmed excessive top padding above 'Choose your vocabulary' and 'Choose a level' so step content starts higher on screen.
Added healthy breathing margins and gaps directly below headers so title and content don't feel squashed together.

entries.summary: Style sense row part of speech as front-card pills and tighten rare uses icon badge placement
detail: Positioned the rare uses count badge snug in the top-left quadrant of the icon (top: 1px, left: 2px) close to the wifi signal bars, creating a tight square icon unit.
Replaced plain colored text for parts of speech in back-of-card sense sections with rounded pill styling (background tint, border-radius: 999px, white text) matching the front of the card.
Aligned sense section headers with align-items: center so the POS pill, lemma, gloss summary, and chevron stay vertically centered.

entries.summary: Omit zero counts from level picker progress legend and unify Smart Skip into action toggle button
detail: Updated the level picker progress stats line to render only categories with counts > 0, eliminating '0 Practice' and '0 Known' when empty.
Unified Smart Skip label and segmented switch into a single centered action button ('Smart Skip · On' / 'Smart Skip · Off').
Styled the unified Smart Skip button to match the visual language, radius, and weight of the Study and Practise buttons.
Maintained centered secondary summary ('Fewer cards, less repetition · Details ›') directly below the toggle button.

entries.summary: Eliminate runaway loading mark reflow loop and detach hidden loading screen to stop CPU overheating
detail: Enforced strict is-hidden checks in applyLoadingMarkImage and updateLoadingMark so background image rotation intervals never run when the loading screen is hidden.
Incremented loading mark generation on hideAppLoading so delayed async image manifest fetches immediately discard their results and never spawn background intervals.
Guarded synchronous offsetWidth layout reads and pop animations so hidden loading elements never trigger forced browser DOM reflows.
Added display: none !important and paused all child CSS keyframe animations on .app-loading-screen.is-hidden so the GPU and layout engine completely detach the overlay.

entries.summary: Integrate desktop song picker into Extra workspace and position Spotify banner below search bar
detail: Integrated the song picking section into the desktop Extra workspace with sidebar and background intact.
Transition seamlessly to full-screen lyrics translation once a song is selected or loaded via Spotify URL.
Reordered the search bar to sit above the Spotify paste link banner across both desktop Extra and modal views.
Added search filtering and language-aware catalogue browsing directly inside desktop Extra.

entries.summary: Clean up Extra workspace: full-screen lyrics translation and remove duplicate titles and navigation
detail: Open lyrics translation full-screen rather than embedding it inside a constrained workspace window.
Remove duplicate titles, eyebrow context pills, and redundant modal close buttons from Extra workspace.
Make lyrics translation card description generic ('lyrics of any song') rather than specific to the current artist.
Document UI guideline in CLAUDE.md to avoid duplicate titles and multi-spot navigation.

entries.summary: Fix card scrubber jumping on touchdown and skipping numbers abruptly
detail: Eliminated touchdown jump when grabbing the scrubber thumb by keeping card position stable on initial touch.
Implemented steady, tactile 18px per card stepping during drag so numbers advance sequentially without skipping.
Preserved direct track tapping so tapping anywhere along the rail continues to seek directly to the tapped position.
